import numpy as np

# Examine L6H0 QK circuit - especially positional component
W_Q6 = W['blocks.6.attn.W_Q'][0]  # head 0, shape [88, 22]
W_K6 = W['blocks.6.attn.W_K'][0]  # head 0
W_V6 = W['blocks.6.attn.W_V'][0]
W_O6 = W['blocks.6.attn.W_O'][0]

W_pos = W['pos_embed.W_pos']  # [10, 88]
W_E = W['embed.W_E']  # [32, 88]

# Compute positional attention logits (just positional component)
Q_pos = W_pos @ W_Q6  # [10, 22]
K_pos = W_pos @ W_K6  # [10, 22]
pos_attn_logits = Q_pos @ K_pos.T / np.sqrt(22)  # [10, 10]
print("=== Positional QK logits for L6H0 ===")
print(np.round(pos_attn_logits, 2))
print("\nSoftmax of positional-only attention:")
def softmax(x, axis=-1):
    e = np.exp(x - x.max(axis=axis, keepdims=True))
    return e / e.sum(axis=axis, keepdims=True)
print(np.round(softmax(pos_attn_logits), 2))

# Also check L2H0 positional QK
W_Q2 = W['blocks.2.attn.W_Q'][0]
W_K2 = W['blocks.2.attn.W_K'][0]

K2_pos = W_pos @ W_K2

print("\n=== Positional QK logits for L2H0 ===")
print(np.round(pos2_logits, 2))
